recovery.note: Recovered exact approved light pixels. Heavy source and old captures were removed by automated scratch maintenance; recaptured generator UI and regenerate heavy from recovered light. No identity redesign.

planning_decision: Recent three at resume are Slakoth, Breloom and Surskit; Gardevoir is also included from this batch. Telescope direction/frame changed to high-angle/three-quarter to avoid Breloom boxing; source values and separates preference adjusted to avoid repeated multisets/triples. Profile-close is new among comparison cuts.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): heart-shaped face, balanced length, medium width; narrow tapered chin; open rounded eyes, large size, level outer corners, average spacing; long arched brows; straight slender bridge nose; small mouth.
faceComparison: Compared recovered light with actual Slakoth, Breloom, Surskit and Gardevoir light images: wider forehead, tapered small chin, larger level eyes and slender nose distinguish the face independently of white waves and eye ornaments.
